svg.title: Phase 2 creation agent flow — what happens when no template match is found
svg.desc: Shows the decision branch where RAG finds no match, triggering the creation agent which proposes a layout, collects user placeholders, runs a human approval loop, then saves and indexes the new template permanently

g.text: "I want a Christmas poster" (no match in DB)
RAG will use this to find it
Saved to templates/ · indexed to ChromaDB · available to all users immediately
